description:
[Calculators] Make a Rust crosshair code from settings, or read one. The crosshair generator (https://rust.wiki/crosshair): start from `code` (or the game's default crosshair),
change any setting, and get back the shareable `code`, the `console` line to paste into F1
(`crosshair.load_code ...`), the page's console `commands` form, the full `settings` and a `page` link that
opens it in the editor preview. Values are rounded to the editor's precision (0.01 for dot and spacing, 0.1 for
length and width), as codes store them. Rust's built-in crosshair editor imports these codes; give the user `console` to paste into F1.

code.description: A crosshair code to read (e.g. `RUST-FceIG-V4T`); other settings given with it are changed on top of it.

color.description: White, Green, Blue, Red, Yellow, Magenta, Cyan or Black (or 0-7).

dynamic_spacing.description: Spread the lines with weapon spread (the game's dynamic spacing).

dynamic_visibility.description: Hide the crosshair while aiming down sights / moving (the game's dynamic visibility).

outline_color.description: Outline colour: Black, Green, Blue, Red, Yellow, Magenta, Cyan or White (or 0-7).

name: make_crosshair
title: Make a Rust crosshair code from settings, or read one
